scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the already-started croissant lamination practical as the same dough batch, preserving usable sheeter-pass evidence for today's laminated-dough competency.
Emerging Need: After check-in and first fold, the assigned sheeter stops mid-pass with the tagged dough trapped and student controls disabled, so the active lamination attempt cannot continue unaided.
Decision Context: Stored requirement and stoppage notes distinguish same-batch continuity from restarting, define the verified equipment route, disclosure limits, and the dough-temperature hold boundary; live records supply the station, batch tag, fault, and contact.
Consequence: Timely supervised release could preserve the run for assessment, while hold expiry makes later release discard-only and unable to salvage this attempt.
